rows.title: The dimorphic brain in ischemic stroke: How sex and age shape molecular pathophysiology and therapeutic responsiveness.
rows.focus: Ischemic stroke remains a leading cause of global mortality and disability, exhibiting marked sexual dimorphism in incidence, severity, and functional outcomes. While epidemiological disparities are well-documented, emerging evidence indicates that these differences are rooted in sex-specific molecular and cellular programs that evolve across the lifespan.
